tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Full record for one instrument by ticker (case-insensitive): yield, risk, custody, availability, how to buy, source link, verification date.

tools.name: compare_with_savings_account
tools.description: Compare low-risk, instant-access crypto savings instruments against a typical bank savings account rate. Returns the honest trade-offs, not just the bigger number.

tools.name: find_permissionless_assets
tools.description: Instruments a self-custody wallet can buy without KYC and hold itself. This is the question a token list cannot answer: for real-world assets the gate to MINT and the gate to BUY on a secondary market routinely differ, so a fund can be permissioned at the issuer while its token trades freely. tools.name: compare_assets
tools.description: Put two or more instruments side by side on the fields that decide between them: yield, risk, minimum, custody, the three access gates, EU availability, issuer and verification date. Use for "X vs Y" questions instead of calling get_product_details repeatedly.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Shape of the dataset: how many instruments, split by pillar, category and risk, how many are EU-available, how many are buyable without KYC, and how fresh the figures are. Use to ground a claim about coverage before making one.

tools.name: get_market_coverage
tools.description: Which countries this dataset can see into, which it cannot, and why — the question "what is tokenized in Japan / Korea / Brazil / India" answers from here rather than from a general search.
